literal: Fear indeed of the base people conduct; remainder, desire if there is, there will be a little.
translation: Fear alone dictates the good conduct of the base. Otherwise, they might show a little good behavior if they desire some gain.
modern: கீழானவர்களின் நல்லொழுக்கம் என்பது அச்சத்தினால் மட்டுமே ஏற்படும். அது தவிர, அவர்களுக்கு ஏதாவது ஒன்றின் மேல் ஆசை இருந்தால் மட்டுமே சிறிது நல்லொழுக்கம் உண்டாகும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the motivations behind any good behavior seen in base individuals. The word 'ācāram' refers to proper conduct or good behavior, which in their case is driven entirely by 'accam' (fear) of punishment or authority. The word 'eccam' means remainder or exception; the only other time they might show a little good conduct is if they have an 'avā' (desire or craving) for some personal gain. Thus, their actions are never guided by inherent virtue, but only by fear or greed.
